listing.name: Ascendant Project 0.1.2 Proof Of Concept
listing.aiSummary: Adds a custom Nexerelin start, unique ship progression system, and early dungeon-style fracture content.

description:
Ascendant Project is a Starsector mod focused around a custom Nexerelin start a unique ship progression system, and early dungeon-style fracture content and custom story.

The mod is currently in active development, so some parts are still placeholders or early implementations, but the main progression loop is already playable. This verstion is for proof of concept.

Current content:

--Custom Nexerelin start

The player can begin with an Ascendant-themed start.

This includes:

-a unique starting location in the Asterion system

-a damaged Ascendant station (The damaged station acts as the main progression hub of the mod.)

-a custom intro sequence (the intro can be played or skipped at the beginning of the campaign)

-an Ascendant Mk I starter ship

The player can restore station modules over time, unlocking new systems and features.

The station is intended to become the center of the Ascendant campaign path.

Ascendant ship progression

The player starts with an Ascendant Mk I ship and can upgrade it to Mk II through station progression. This system is still being expanded and balanced.

Blacksite / Tri-Tachyon mini-crisis

The current main boss path is tied to a small Tri-Tachyon blacksite mini-crisis.

After progressing through the relevant content, the player encounters a boss event connected to Tri-Tachyon research and Ascendant technology.

At the moment, the Tesseract is used as a placeholder boss. It is not intended to be the final version of the boss encounter. The current boss fight exists to test the progression, crisis flow, combat trigger, rewards, and overall structure.

The boss path currently ends after the Tri-Tachyon mini-crisis.

Echo Fracture dungeon:

The mod also includes the first version of fracture/dungeon content.

The player can use the restored Fracture Cartography Core at the Ascendant Station to temporarily repurpose the Asterion Gate and open access to the Echo Fracture. The Warden Echo is based on the idea of a lost high-tech fleet preserved inside the fracture as a repeating command-state. It is not a normal fleet, but an echo of a final tactical order that never ended.

Planned / future content:

-cross-mod interactions

-replacing the Tesseract placeholder with a proper custom Ascendant boss (duh)

-expanding the crisis chain

-adding more fracture dungeons

-adding more station modules and upgrades

-expanding Ascendant ship progression

-improving rewards and unique items

-adding more lore and post-boss consequences

-deeper integration with the Asterion system and Ascendant Station

This mod is still a work in progress. Balance, text, rewards, encounters, and progression may change between versions.

Feedback is welcome, especially:

-balance of the Ascendant starter ship

-station progression pacing

-dungeon/fracture content

-mini-crisis flow

Sprites: ¥6G Art Support: Vexlia Artemiss

Needed: Nexerelin

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=9175.0

Download:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1II-uKeTARyKB8oXwi35D87ZTf-dvkCO2/view?usp=sharing

Changelog:

Spoiler

CHECK IF MOD IS ENABLED, I CHANGED MOD ID

Next patch will add Hegemony crisis and balance tweaks

--- Version 0.1.2 ---

Reworked Echo Fracture:

-added the Fractured Echo Spire. The player must now eliminate the Warden before exiting. The Return Aperture has been removed.

-caches no longer respawn endlessly.

Fixed Garou Labs compatibility issue:

-previously, the mod could cause a crash on startup.

Fixed Exotic Technologies compatibility issue:

-this was my mistake; it should now work properly.

If an Ascendant ship has a D-mod, the station will now detect it and block retrofitting.

---Version 0.1.1---

Performance fix

---Version 0.1.0---

Mod Release
